key_insight: EgoWM converts pretrained video diffusion models into action-conditioned egocentric world models, enabling controllable, plausible future prediction without training from scratch by repurposing Internet-scale video priors.
problem_solved: How to produce accurate, action-conditioned future video predictions (especially from a first-person/egocentric view) while avoiding costly training from scratch and leveraging large pretrained video generative models.
method: Take an off-the-shelf pretrained video diffusion model and reuse its learned world priors instead of training a new model.
Inject action-conditioning into the generation process via lightweight conditioning/adapters that modulate sampling to reflect intended actions (architecture-agnostic).
Generate controllable future frames in egocentric view by steering the pretrained diffusion sampler with the action signals, enabling correct-to-the-action predictions.
impact: Provides a practical, sample-efficient path to build action-aware world models for robotics, AR/VR, and interactive agents by leveraging existing large-scale generative video models—reducing compute and data needs while improving controllability.

paper_title: Walk through Paintings: Egocentric World Models from Internet Priors
